description: Find Philippine scholarships and student financial aid that match a question, in English or Taglish (e.g. "incoming college, BS Engineering", "anak ng OFW", "TESDA courses", "grad school science"). Searches a curated list of programs (DOST, CHED, TESDA, OWWA, LGUs, foundations, universities) where every fact was checked against the official page. Returns the best matches with summary, period and official URL. Use ph_get_scholarship for full eligibility and benefits. Never state amounts or deadlines the results do not contain.

level.description: Only return programs for this level (detected from the query if omitted)

query.description: What the student is looking for, in English or Taglish

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text (default), 'json' for structured data

name: ph_search_scholarships
title: Search Philippine scholarships
